body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/cylinder-volume-d_364.html LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump piston stroke not on the catalogue Why LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump Prints No Piston Stroke Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The row does list Theoretical Output The row does list Theoretical Output 50 m³/h and Pumping Pressure 35 MPa. A piston displaces concrete into the line; a squeeze pump compresses a hose. The sheet does not choose between them by inventing a stroke. The frame “Road roller” shows A Caterpillar CS-533E vibratory roller and adds no stroke figure. Named parts are not a service procedure The wear-part list elsewhere names pistons and swing-arm parts as replacement sizes. This LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump row does not turn those names into a torque, an hour interval or a material grade beyond what this row already lists. Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm. Total Weight 5500 kg. The frame does not supply the missing stroke Subject: A Caterpillar CS-533E vibratory roller. If a piston or valve is visible there, that is the subject of the frame. It is not a measured stroke for LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump. Keep the listed duty Theoretical Output 50 m³/h. Pumping Pressure 35 MPa. Pipeline length still has to be read from this model's own distance cells, not from the frame and not from a different pump. Does LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump list a piston stroke? No. What duty is listed instead? Theoretical Output 50 m³/h and Pumping Pressure 35 MPa. Does a piston in the frame set the stroke? No. The frame is not a stroke measurement. Are service hours listed? No. Hours, torque and price stay unprinted. Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei, China A Caterpillar CS-533E vibratory roller. Subject of the frame for the LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump catalogue note, Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei
